headline:
رمز GTA VI المطبوع يعمل فقط
مع حساب بلد النسخة
label: رسمي
credits: المصدر: بلاي ستيشن (PlayStation)، لقطات روكستار (Rockstar Games)
note: Story type RELEASE/EXPLAINER (regional, Gulf). Primary read: PlayStation UAE support page playstation.com/en-ae/support/games/gta-vi-compatibility (5 Nov 2026): GTA VI Code-in-Box codes work only with PlayStation accounts registered to the region on the code; Saudi Arabia and United Arab Emirates are separate entries ('Code can only be used by users holding an account for PlayStation registered to Saudi Arabia / the United Arab Emirates'); page gives no dates; launch 19 Nov 2026 per Rockstar trailer end card (PS5, Xbox Series X|S). Footage: Rockstar official Trailer 2 (media-rockstargames-com.akamaized.net/VI/downloads/videos/GTAVI_Trailer_2), cut to two 1080p stretches (28 to 70 s and 138 to 152 s of the original), shots chosen clean: no violence, no sexual content, no slate. Illustration only. Sensitive: none. genre: open world.
